concerns.text: Task T111 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it runs a full end‑to‑end timing wrapper that executes the entire pipeline (download → preprocess → train → evaluate → validate). Running this concurrently with any other task that writes the same artifacts (e.g., T103‑T108) would cause race conditions and corrupt outputs. The `[P]` tag is therefore unsafe.

Task T112 updates SHA‑256 hashes for all major artifacts. If executed in parallel with tasks that are still producing those artifacts, the hash manifest could capture incomplete or partially‑written files. This makes the `[P]` designation incorrect.

Task T114 re‑runs the entire documented workflow from a clean slate to generate a reproducibility report. By definition it must be the final step and cannot safely run in parallel with any other task that manipulates the same directories. The `[P]` tag should be removed.
